purpose: Predeclare P0 family thesis, data contract, negative controls, fixture plan, and promotion boundary before spending new R&D budget.
shared_rules: No family may read candles after the signal timestamp when forming entry signals.
Closed-candle OHLCV and supplemental data must carry checksum or manifest coverage evidence before promotion.
Panel research and scorer outputs are research artifacts, not strategy evidence.
A rejected mechanism cannot be rerun by only adding filters; it needs a new return driver, portfolio shape, or data surface.

families.hypothesis: Trend continuation can offer better executable entries after pullback than chasing the impulse.
families.temporal_contract: Signal uses candles through bar t; entry is next open or executable quote after t closes.
families.promotion_boundary: Runnable replay family, but current BTC 4H variants have been rejected; revisit only with a distinct thesis certificate.

families.hypothesis: A causal structure break followed by a defended retest can identify continuation with defined invalidation.
families.temporal_contract: Structure level must be computed only from pre-break history; retest confirmation must be known before entry.
families.promotion_boundary: Latest panel SBR attempt failed OOS and catastrophic veto; no new trials without a new mechanism.

families.hypothesis: Medium-horizon single-asset momentum persists after costs when trend quality is causal and stable.
families.temporal_contract: Return lookback ends at signal close; entry uses next bar open; labels crossing OOS boundary must be purged.
families.promotion_boundary: Prefer panel momentum before more BTC-only filters because recent failures were null/regime/sample driven.

families.hypothesis: Low realized range followed by breakout can monetize post-compression expansion.
families.temporal_contract: Compression window and breakout trigger must be fully known at signal close; entry cannot use breakout bar future high.
families.promotion_boundary: Budget was exhausted on BTC VCB; any follow-up must change return driver or portfolio shape.

families.hypothesis: Asset weakness versus benchmark can continue when beta-adjusted relative trend is persistent.
families.temporal_contract: Relative score must use asset and benchmark closes available at the same signal timestamp.
families.promotion_boundary: Bridge family only; full asset-selection edge should use cross-sectional panel ranking.

families.hypothesis: Assets with enough quote volume, stable coverage, and lower OHLCV impact proxy are safer candidates for R&D and execution.
families.temporal_contract: Gate can only use data available before the strategy evaluation window it filters.
families.promotion_boundary: Universe gate only; never standalone alpha or strategy promotion evidence.

families.hypothesis: Within a marketability-filtered crypto universe, recent relative winners may continue outperforming losers over short holding windows.
families.temporal_contract: Ranks are formed at signal close from lookback returns; entries use next aligned bar open; rebalance dates are fixed before evaluation.
families.promotion_boundary: Panel research only until portfolio construction, sizing, rebalance, and multi-leg execution contract exist.

families.hypothesis: Within a marketability-filtered crypto universe, short-term relative underperformers may mean-revert when not in strong crash regimes.
families.temporal_contract: Ranks are formed at signal close from causal underperformance or overextension; entries use next aligned bar open.
families.promotion_boundary: Panel research only; needs crash-regime controls and portfolio construction before strategy draft.

families.hypothesis: Perp funding, premium, and open-interest pressure can create directional or carry returns after explicit funding cashflow and costs.
families.temporal_contract: Funding events must be charged at their actual settlement time; missing gaps above 9 hours block research and promotion evidence.
families.promotion_boundary: Funding governance passed for the current calibration panel; latest real panel research still failed cost and catastrophic-loss gates, so no strategy policy may be drafted from it.

families.hypothesis: Family performance is conditional on volatility, trend breadth, beta, funding pressure, and marketability regimes.
families.temporal_contract: Regime label must be computed before the strategy decision and evaluated against always-on baselines.
families.promotion_boundary: Router can authorize allow-list or no-trade first; it is not standalone alpha.
